notes.title: Meet - The Kid
notes.notes:
Yo what is hangin future heroes?

Are you ready to learn the ins and outs of the dart gun wielding embodiment of everyone's younger brother?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43701934/cedba814d9fc1bb021a100d99deaa32c74c569aa.png[/img]

[i]The Kid[/i]

The Kid specializes in close quarters combat, or CQB.  He wields a dart gun, which fires slow moving projectiles.  However his gun has a very quick rate of fire allowing him to excel at engaging enemies that are very close.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43701934/ee6b21998451c30fdd4ea19112800640d80cb59e.png[/img]

[i]The Kid's stats[/i]

The Kid Has very average stats, except for a low bullet speed, which is countered by his high rate of fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43701934/991c88bd088ed68eb00813971338dbb0a7e19cd7.gif[/img]

[i]Enjoy this compressed gif of me destroying an easy cpu[/i]

We hope you like this new approach to showcasing heroes, and now that me and my brother are off of Christmas/new year break.  We are back at full swing development!

Cheers Heroes!

notes.title: The Night of the Living Mushroom!
notes.notes:
Prepare for an unforgettable encounter as we introduce our first boss in Twin Stick Heroes 2 - The Living Mushroom!

🍄 Meet the Mysterious Foe: Standing as a massive monolith of mystery in the dark, tangled forests of Gord City, The Living Mushroom is unlike anything you've ever seen. Its imposing presence will test your heroics to the limit.

💨 Robots on the Rampage: Defeating this formidable fungi won't be a walk in the park. Ntech's relentless deforestation robots have set their sights on the lush, ancient forests. You'll need to dodge, duck, and dive to avoid their deadly arsenal.

🍄 Fungal Warfare: The Living Mushroom doesn't stand alone. It has the ability to spawn smaller mushroom outcrops. To conquer the colossal cap, you'll need to take out these smaller growths while dodging both the fungal hazards and Ntech's relentless machines.

💎 Rewards Await: Triumph over The Living Mushroom, and you'll earn exclusive in-game rewards to aid you on your galactic journey.

🌌 Explore the Cosmos: The battle with The Living Mushroom is just one of many adventures in Twin Stick Heroes 2. Expect additional boss encounters, heroes, and cosmic wonders as you journey through the vast universe.

🌐 Join the Fight: Are you ready to take on the challenge of The Living Mushroom? Wishlist Twin Stick Heroes 2 now, and brace for action, strategy, and an immersive multiplayer experience.

In the darkest corners of the galaxy, only the bravest will rise. Will you be one of them?

Stay tuned for further updates as we prepare for the game's launch. Your support means the world to us!

Cheers! - The Burnett Bros!
